title: fix: cmd_list_keys leaks PKCS#11 session on C_FindObjectsInit failure
description:
In src/cli/wp11_cli.c cmd_list_keys, if C_FindObjectsInit fails (~line 319), the code closes the session via C_CloseSession but never calls C_Finalize. The function then continues to the next slot iteration. C_Finalize is only called at the success/final exit path (~line 408) and one early error path (~line 293).

Bad behavior: On a slot where find-objects setup fails, the library remains initialized with open state. If the loop exits without hitting the success path, C_Finalize is never called, leaving the PKCS#11 library in initialized state after the CLI exits.

Fix: Restructure cmd_list_keys with a single cleanup label that always calls C_Finalize, or add C_Finalize before each early return.
